<!--
Catryna keeps a deliberately narrow scope: local-first docs in .docs/,
readable by agents and humans, and kept honest by drift detection. Ideas
outside that are still welcome; say so up front so the discussion stays
grounded.
-->

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who runs into it? Concrete examples
land better than abstract framings.

## Proposed solution

What would you like Catryna to do? If you have a sketch of the CLI, MCP tool,
or doc format, include it.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.

## Scope

Which part of Catryna does this touch? Pick any that apply:

- [ ] MCP tools (agent-facing)
- [ ] CLI (`catryna drift`, `verify`, `lint`, …)
- [ ] Drift detection
- [ ] Docs viewer
- [ ] Doc format / storage
- [ ] Not sure: would like maintainer input
